fuse.name: SECONDARY_KEY_DERIVATION_KEY_READ_DISABLE
fuse.description: Recommendation is to provide --fuse-secondary-key-derivation-key-read-disable. This bit determines the read permission setting for this region.

fuse.name: READ_PERMISSIONS_WRITE_DISABLE
fuse.description: Recommendation is to provide --fuse-read-permissions-write-disable. Disables further QFPROM changes to the this region. Blow this bit after the region has been completely provisioned.

fuse.name: OEM_IMAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FEC_ENABLE
fuse.description: Recommendation is to provide --fuse-oem-image-encryption-key-fec-enable. This fuse is used to enable the Forward Error Correction for this region (if applicable).

fuse.name: OEM_SECURE_BOOT_FEC_ENABLE
fuse.description: Recommendation is to provide --fuse-oem-secure-boot-fec-enable. This fuse is used to enable the Forward Error Correction for this region (if applicable).

fuse.name: SECONDARY_KEY_DERIVATION_KEY_FEC_ENABLE

fuse.name: OEM_SPARE_28_FEC_ENABLE

fuse.name: OEM_SPARE_29_FEC_ENABLE

fuse.name: E_DLOAD_DISABLE
fuse.description: SW only use for Boot. Disable the removable SD and then USB downloader in Apps PBL error handler, as well as the method to force download during code boot via magic cookies in IMEM.

fuse.name: ENUM_TIMEOUT
fuse.description: SW only use for Boot. BOOT ROM must support USB enumeration timeout. Timeout applies to both enumeration for FLCB (fast low current boot) and USB download mode. If USB is not enumerated within time (90 seconds), quit USB enumeration If USB suspend or disconnected after enumeration, start timer again.

fuse.name: FORCE_DLOAD_DISABLE
fuse.description: SW only use for Boot. To disable method to force boot from USB via GPIO or magic number in RAM.

fuse.name: FAST_BOOT
fuse.description:
These fuses are used by boot code to specify which device has priority to be booted from. For SRV1L/SA8620P/SA7255P, the mapping is as follows:
Following change is needed for fast boot options: 0000b -> UFS-USB 0001b -> eMMC-USB 0010b -> USB 0011b -> UFS-USB Rest are reserved. If selected, treated as invalid boot option.

fuse.name: SW_FUSE_PROG_DISABLE
fuse.description: This fuse disables the ability to write fuses through the software interface.

fuse.name: PBL_FDL_TIMEOUT_RESET_FEATURE_ENABLE
fuse.description: Fuse bit to reset device if PBL enters into EDL mode unintentionally.

fuse.name: WDOG_EN
fuse.description: Recommendation is to provide --fuse-wdog-en. Combined with GPIO Wdog disable (connects to MPM). Prevents the Watch Dog from being disabled by the GPIO.

fuse.name: PBL_LOG_DISABLE
fuse.description: SW only use for Boot. Control logging mechanism in Boot ROM (If blown, Logging is disabled & mandated for external parts).

fuse.name: ROOT_CERT_TOTAL_NUM
fuse.description: Defines the number of additional root certificates used to sign images containing multiple root certificates (MRC). For example, specify a value of 1 if images are signed with 2 root certificates and specify a value of 3 if images are signed with 4 root certificates. Do not blow if images are signed with a single root certificate.

fuse.name: IMAGE_ENCRYPTION_ENABLE
fuse.description: This bit is used to indicate whether image encryption is enabled. When this bit is unblown, encrypted images will not be decryptable by the device. If blown, encryption keys must also be provisioned in order for decryption to function. Note that this bit only 'enables' the image encryption feature, and is NOT an encryption enforcement bit. With image encryption enabled, the chip can boot with either encrypted or plaintext images (the image has meta-data to indicate if the image is encrypted or not).

fuse.name: SW_ROT_USE_SERIAL_NUM
fuse.description: If set, PBL checks that signature covers a serial number that matches that read from fuses. This is for secure boot authentication.

fuse.name: USB_SS_DISABLE
fuse.description: Used to disable USB SS enumeration during Boot.

fuse.name: DEBUG_POLICY_DISABLE
fuse.description: Recommendation is to not provide --fuse-debug-policy-disable. Debug Policy is bypassed when this bit is 1. Debug Policy provides a means to re-enable debug capabilities under OEM-specified selectable conditions.

fuse.name: ALL_DEBUG_DISABLE
fuse.description: Recommendation is to not provide --fuse-all-debug-disable. This fuse permanently disables all debug of the chip. This should only be blown once the OEM is done with their development and testing. No RMAs are possible after this fuse is blown.

fuse.name: SHARED_QSEE_SPIDEN_DISABLE
fuse.description: Recommendation is to provide --fuse-shared-qsee-spiden-disable. Shared QSEE Secure Invasive Debug Disable bucket. This OEM controlled fuse can be overriden by the corresponding QC fuse.

fuse.name: SHARED_QSEE_SPNIDEN_DISABLE
fuse.description: Recommendation is to provide --fuse-shared-qsee-spniden-disable. Shared QSEE Secure Non-invasive Debug Disable bucket. This OEM controlled fuse can be overriden by the corresponding QC fuse.

fuse.name: SHARED_MSS_DBGEN_DISABLE
fuse.description: Recommendation is to provide --fuse-shared-mss-dbgen-disable. Shared MSS Invasive Debug Disable bucket. This OEM controlled fuse can be overriden by the corresponding QC fuse.

fuse.name: SHARED_MSS_NIDEN_DISABLE

fuse.name: SHARED_CP_DBGEN_DISABLE

fuse.name: APPS_DBGEN_DISABLE
fuse.description: Recommendation is to provide --fuse-apps-dbgen-disable. When blown will disable the non-secure invasive debug facilities of APPS (including APPS processor) subsystem. This OEM controlled fuse can be overriden by the corresponding QC fuse.

fuse.name: APPS_NIDEN_DISABLE
fuse.description: Recommendation is to provide --fuse-apps-niden-disable. When blown will disable the non-secure non-invasive debug facilities of APPS (including APPS processor) subsystem. This OEM controlled fuse can be overriden by the corresponding QC fuse.

fuse.name: SHARED_MISC_DEBUG_DISABLE
fuse.description: Shared Misc Debug Disable bucket. This OEM controlled fuse can be overriden by the corresponding QC fuse.

fuse.name: USB_PIPO_DISABLE
fuse.description: This fuse is used to control the USB PIPO mode.

fuse.name: TZ_SW_CRYPTO_FIPS_ENABLE
fuse.description: Enable FIPS mode for TZ software crypto. Disable by default and blow to enable.

fuse.name: TZ_SW_CRYPTO_FIPS_OVERRIDE
fuse.description: Override TZ_SW_CRYPTO_FIPS_ENABLE fuse. Non-override by default and blow to override the TZ_SW_CRYPTO_FIPS_ENABLE fuse to disable the FIPS feature in TZ.

fuse.name: SPARE_REG28_SECURE
fuse.description: This fuse determines if the corresponding OEM spare region is treated as secure. If blown, it indicates secure, and the region has the properties of a customer private key, and is not readable through SW while debug is enabled.

fuse.name: SPARE_REG29_SECURE
fuse.description: This fuse determines if the corresponding OEM spare region is treated as secure. If blown, it indicates secure, and the region has the properties of a customer private key, and is not readable through SW while debug is enabled.

fuse.name: SPARE_REG30_SECURE
fuse.description: This fuse determines if the corresponding OEM spare region is treated as secure. If blown, it indicates secure, and the region has the properties of a customer private key, and is not readable through SW while debug is enabled. This region is reserved for DOLBY and will be blown by QC.

fuse.name: SPARE_REG31_SECURE
fuse.description: This fuse determines if the corresponding OEM spare region is treated as secure. If blown, it indicates secure, and the region has the properties of a customer private key, and is not readable through SW while debug is enabled. This region is reserved for DOLBY and will be blown by QC.

fuse.description: SEGMENT_HASH_FUNCTION_SELECT_0 is used to determine segment hash computation algorithm with MRC 0 Indexed Root Certificate enabled. 0 means SHA384, 1 means SHA256.

fuse.name: SEGMENT_HASH_FUNCTION_SELECT1

fuse.name: SEGMENT_HASH_FUNCTION_SELECT2

fuse.name: SEGMENT_HASH_FUNCTION_SELECT3

fuse.name: EKU_ENFORCEMENT_EN
fuse.description: Recommendation is to provide --fuse-eku-enforcement-en. When this fuse is blown will enable enforcement of the EKU field in the certificate.

fuse.name: DISABLE_RSA
fuse.description: When this bit is 0 and signed image type is SHA384 + RSA/ECC is 0 -> RSA OPERATION. When this bit is 0 and signed image type is SHA384 + RSA/ECC IS 1 -> ECC OPERATION USING PKA IP. When this bit is 1 and signed image type is SHA384 + RSA/ECC is 0 -> Error. When this bit is 1 and signed image type is SHA384 + RSA/ECC IS 1 -> ECC OPERATION USING PKA IP.

fuse.name: OEM_SECURE_BOOT1_ROM_PK_HASH_IDX0
fuse.description: Recommendation is to not provide --fuse-oem-secure-boot1-rom-pk-hash-idx0. If PK_HASH_IN_FUSE = '0', this value selects which root certificate hash to use from the ROM table. To use the RSA root certificate hash, set this bit to '0'. To use the ECDSA root certificate hash, set this bit to '1'.

fuse.name: OEM_SECURE_BOOT1_PK_HASH_IN_FUSE
fuse.description: Recommendation is to provide --fuse-oem-secure-boot1-pk-hash-in-fuse. For boot configuration : If this bit is '0' use the shared OEM root in ROM for the root certificate hash. When using this root all signed images must be bound to OEM ID, and the same OEM ID must be blown in fuses. If this bit is '1' use the value stored in PK_HASH_0 for the root certificate hash.

fuse.name: SEC_KEY_DERIVATION_KEY
fuse.description: This 256-bit value is used as the secondary key derivation input; used to generate the secondary key used by the crypto engine. When running insecure (no secure boot; or Debug enabled) then SKDK is fed into the key derivation function to generate a unique "non-secure" secondary key for use by the crypto engine. When running secure (secure boot; and debug disabled), then SKDK is fed directly to the crypto engine as the secondary key.After the SKDK value has been correctly programmed, the SKDK Read Disable should be blown to permanently protect the SKDK value. Prior to this, the SKDK value can be read from the QFPROM by software. The TZ fuse blow API is capable of automatically generating a random number for use as the SKDK so that the SKDK value is never available outside of the device.
